problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 3x+5y=-6 \\  & -6x-6y=10.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 \\ -6 & -6 & 10\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 \\ -6 & -6 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{5}{3} & -2 \\ -6 & -6 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+6{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{5}{3} & -2 \\ 0 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{5}{3} & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
